accent-purple.role: soft mint; the name is a compat leftover, NOT purple

accent-primary.role: darker lime so it passes AA as text; buttons use white --on-accent text

contrast.fixedInRound10: dark muted #67736D was 3.85:1; light muted #7B857F was 3.54:1; light lime #5E9E08 was 3.06:1; light mint #0C9E7C was 3.14:1; light danger #D94836 was 3.95:1 — all below AA and all used as text
contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance, computed from the hex values; AA bar is 4.5:1 for normal text. Verified by tests/design-tokens.test.cjs on every run.

motion.rule: only state changes: progress fill, spinner, toast, panel open. 150-400ms, transform/opacity only. Reduced motion collapses everything to 0.01ms (see animations.css).

name: HireMind AI — Atlas design tokens
note: One lime accent on a cool green-grey neutral ramp. Every token is declared in src/styles/globals.css twice — hex fallback, then the exact OKLCH conversion (checked with culori) — so both lines render the same colour. Accent covers under 10% of any screen: it marks the single most important number, the active nav item, or the primary action, and nowhere else.
signatureIdea: The audit ledger: one thin lime rule and one tabular figure mark the number that matters on each screen — the ATS score on the resume page, the readiness ring on the dashboard, the aggregate score on the interview summary. Everything else is quiet ink, 1px borders and solid surfaces. No glows, no gradients, no frosted glass.

type.bodySize: 14px — deliberate dashboard density (Linear-style), not a default
type.mono: JetBrains Mono (code, file names, report output)
type.text: Inter (body, labels, data — tabular numerals on scores and counts)
